entities.name: big pollarded willow at the top, by the S3 seam
entities.what: Old pollarded willow on the north bank at the silk's top edge: a dark, gnarled trunk with a knobbed head about 80 px below the edge, from which long bare whips radiate in every direction, the western ones drooping toward the moored boats. Single trunk, standing nearly upright with a slight lean east; leafless spring whips.
entities.vis: part: crown cut by the silk's top edge; foot hidden behind the roof of the boat moored below
entities.note: S2's by the seam rule (map/index.md, brief: the big willow at the top is S2's even if its trunk reads west of 20500); its base reads east of 20500 anyway. Knobbed head about u 20520-20560, v 85-130; trunk u 20550-20585 at v 150-210, then down-west to u 20530-20555 at v 240-270, where the moored boat's roof (v ~275-290) hides the foot: base est at the bank top. A pale shape against the trunk's east side at u 20575-20600, v 150-200 may be a small figure (S2.fig.figure_by_top_willow_20590, conf low) or pale bark (the restyle draws a pale hollow there, no person). Crown extremes are where the whips fade; the west whips overlap S3's hut and tavern roofs (u 20380-20500), the east ones overlap S2.tree.willow_top_20668's crown.

entities.name: possible small figure at the top willow's trunk (low confidence)
entities.what: Possibly a small standing person in a light robe, half hidden against the east side of the big top willow's dark trunk in front of the wattle fence, head turned west. Low confidence: it may be pale bark on the knotted trunk.
entities.vis: part: body against the trunk; feet not readable
entities.note: BOTH READINGS: at zoom 2 the pale shape u 20575-20600, v 150-200 reads as a small figure: a round head (u 20585-20597, v 150-167, darker on top), shoulders, a long light robe with a dark stroke down it (arm?), against the trunk's dark east side; about 70 px tall with the foot est at the fence's foot line (v ~210-230), which suits the north bank's diminution. At zoom 4-5 it breaks up into pale patches on the knotted trunk, and the restyle draws a pale hollow in the bark there (no person). Named in S2.tree.willow_top_20552's note. Keep only if the second pass confirms a face.

entities.name: second pollarded willow at the top, with two knobbed heads
entities.what: Pollarded willow on the north bank just east of the big one, in front of a slatted wattle fence: a twisted trunk leaning north-east up the silk that forks into two knobbed heads, each sprouting bare whips that reach the silk's top edge. Leafless spring whips.
entities.vis: part: crown cut by the silk's top edge
entities.note: Trunk foot u 20650-20687, v 207-227 (base = its middle where it meets the bank); trunk rises to (20700, 100); heads at u 20673-20707, v 60-110 and u 20730-20765, v 17-67. The restyle draws it as a separate willow with its own base at about (20660, 230): it agrees. A double line (a mooring rope) starts at about (20660, 200) by its foot and runs down-east to the boat moored along the north bank (river_w's: the rope is part of the boat). Not in the brief's list: a second top willow.

entities.name: great dark-trunked tree on the south bank at the bottom edge
entities.what: Massive old tree on the south bank, the darkest thing at the bottom of the silk: a thick, gnarled, knotty trunk rising from the silk's bottom edge to a knobbed head at about v 1300, with one pale, straight limb leaning far up-west and a fan of long, thin, bare straight shoots rising from the head into the middle of the silk over the water. Read as a pollarded old willow in spring (bare whips); could also be a bare elm-like tree.
entities.vis: part: foot cut by the silk's bottom edge (v ~1776)
entities.note: SEAM: S3's brief gives t9 'the big bare tree with the dark trunk (base ~20330-20420 at the bottom edge, crown to ~20800)' and S2's brief gives t1 'the second dark willow trunk at ~20480-20600'. On the scan there is only ONE dark trunk here (zoom 0.8 view u 19900-20900): at the bottom edge it spans u ~20465-20600 (centre ~20530), with the S3 stall, its parasol and the hanging garments (u 20150-20470) west of it and no trunk at u 20330-20420. By its base it is S2's; S3's t9 may record it too: keep one. Trunk: u 20412-20610 at v 1350-1560 (a dark mass on its west side at u 20412-20460, v 1350-1500 is shadow or a second stem), u 20465-20600 at v 1600-1776; knobbed head u 20515-20610, v 1230-1380; pale limb from (20487, 1350) up to (20394, 1094); shoots' tips about v 700-760 over u 20310-20600, and out to u ~20830 at v 750-1000 (east tips mix with the whips of t2's great willow). The restyle paints figures climbing in its knobbed head (u ~20440-20600, v 1230-1460): not painted, only knobs and a pale knot at (20600-20620, 1316-1339). A pale patch between its east side and the south-bank roof's west eave (u 20600-20645, v 1630-1700) reads at a glance like a profile face, but at 45 x 60 px it is twice a figure's head here: the gap between trunk and eave brackets (the restyle draws a wall and brackets). Second pass (west): the pale patch under the hall's west eave is kept as S2.fig.figure_under_eave_20625 (low): at 45-50 px it matches the big-hat man's 40 px face at v 1712, so it is not too big for a face this near the bottom edge. The long straight shoot at u ~20645 (v ~900-1340) springs from this tree's knobbed head (it bends into the head's east edge at v ~1340-1370); the stems at u 20700-20720 do not (S2.tree.bare_south_bank_20705).

entities.name: small loose wheel by the low wall
entities.what: A small spoked wheel (or a round wooden tub seen obliquely) standing on its edge at the foot of a low wall or ledge on the north bank, between the slatted fence and the shop's corner post.
entities.note: Oval rim u 20953-20975, v 132-147 (about 22 x 15 px, SCALE CUE) with an inner arc and a dark hub mark at (20963, 135); it leans against the low wall's line at v ~126 (u 20937-20975), which is structures_w's. The restyle draws it as a cartwheel leaning on the wall with a stone beside it.

entities.name: table inside the open shop front
entities.what: A plain wooden table (or long bench-table) with a stretcher between its legs, standing inside the open front of the tiled shop on the north bank, its long side to the street; a round basket stands on its back edge. Nobody at it.
entities.note: Top board u 21128-21192, v 105-110; front legs at (21135, 138) and (21190, 137); stretcher at v ~120. About 64 px long, top ~30 px above its feet (SCALE CUE at foot v 138). Receding edge: the top's west end is drawn lower/nearer than its east end only slightly: (21128, 110) -> (21192, 105), not a usable depth direction. The shop's columns at u 21083-21097 and 21197-21203 are structures_w's.

entities.name: round basket on the shop table
entities.what: A small round wicker basket (or bowl) with a rim, set on the back edge of the table inside the open shop front.
entities.note: u 21171-21190, v 88-103 (about 19 px across). The restyle paints it as a dark lidded pot.

entities.name: man seated on the south bank, holding something up
entities.what: Man in a long light robe with dark hair, sitting on the ground of the south bank at the water's edge, seen from behind, his robe spread around him and his legs toward the east; he faces east toward the tall man, and a small round object (a cup, a jar or a ring on a short stick) shows held up just above his head. A long pole or board crosses in front of him at chest height toward the tall man, with cloth-like folds hanging under it.
entities.vis: part: face turned away; willow whips cross him
entities.note: Dark head (hair) u 21057-21083, v 1262-1285; robe u 21047-21165, v 1280-1375, its lower edge at v ~1367-1375; foot est at the east end of the robe where the feet must be. Seated painted height ~110 px. The loop above his head (u 21067-21100, v 1230-1260) with a vertical stroke down from (21093, 1235) to (21093, 1290) is the held object; the restyle reads it as the head and raised hands of a second person (S2.fig.bank_figure_raised_hands_21085, conf low). The horizontal double line at u 21095-21165, v 1283-1300 is the pole or board (the restyle paints a tray of wares between him and the tall man): held, so part of the figures, not a prop. Just north of him the small covered boat lies at the bank (river_w's), its hull's lower edge at v ~1210-1235.

entities.name: possible second person behind the seated man (raised hands)
entities.what: A possible second person kneeling or sitting just behind the seated man, of whom only a small head-sized loop shows above his head, as if a woman lifting both hands to her hair. Low confidence: it may be the object the seated man holds up.
entities.vis: part: only the loop at the head shows; body hidden by the seated man
entities.note: BOTH READINGS: (a) the loop u 21067-21100, v 1230-1260 is a small object (cup, jar or ring on a stick) held up by S2.fig.bank_man_seated_21140, which is how the scan reads at zoom 2; (b) it is the head of a second person with raised hands, as the restyle paints it (a woman in a dark jacket with hands at her hair, the white-robed seated man in front). No body, hands or feet of a second person are visible on the scan; if she stood she would show beside him, so foot est as kneeling behind him. Keep only if the second pass reads a face in the loop.

entities.name: tall man standing on the south bank
entities.what: Man in a long robe and a dark cap, standing on the south bank at the west foot of the great willow, his head bent and turned down-west toward the seated man, his hands together at his chest holding something small. The biggest figure of the group.
entities.vis: part: feet hidden where the south-bank roof's ridge passes below them
entities.note: Cap top v 1232 (u 21192-21227), face v 1247-1270; robe u 21160-21235, hem at v ~1415-1430; feet est at (21205, 1428) just above the roof ridge line (v ~1432-1445 here). Painted height ~196 px (foot v 1428), far larger than S4's road figures at this v: he is the near bank's biggest figure; the small figure beside him is ~145 px. Hands at u 21170-21210, v 1295-1340. The restyle gives him a blue robe and a cap, holding a small white thing.

entities.name: smaller figure (child or youth?) facing the tall man
entities.what: A smaller person with dark hair (child or youth?) standing between the tall man and the great willow's trunk, facing west toward him; plain robe, body half lost against the dark trunk.
entities.vis: part: lower body and feet faint against the trunk
entities.note: Head u 21245-21280, v 1267-1298 (dark hair on top, face to the west); body u 21220-21280, v 1298-1400; feet est. Painted height ~145 px against the tall man's ~200 (0.72): a child, a youth or a woman. The restyle paints a child in red here, and a THIRD figure behind it (dark hair, u 21271-21300, v 1270-1330) plus a blue shape in the trunk (u 21330-21380): on the scan the dark mass at u 21273-21303, v 1268-1300 has the trunk's knotted hatching and no face, so it is not recorded (named here for the second pass). The trunk itself (base ~21350) is t2's.

entities.name: crouching figure with a dark cap (low confidence)
entities.what: A small figure crouching or bending low on the south bank in front of the tall man, seen from above: a dark rounded cap or hood over a pale jacket, its lower body cut off by the roof ridge in front. Could instead be a dark basket set on a pale bundle.
entities.vis: part: lower body hidden by the south-bank roof's ridge
entities.note: BOTH READINGS: dark rounded shape u 21128-21162, v 1374-1398 above a lighter band (v 1398-1406) and a pale outlined body u 21130-21182, v 1402-1444 cut by the roof ridge: (a) a crouching person (child?) with a dark cap, as the restyle paints it (a figure in blue with a dark cap bending down); (b) a dark round basket on a pale sack or box, which would make it a prop at the same base. Head 34 px across, about a head's size here; visible height ~60 px.

entities.name: people on the south bank by the small covered boat
entities.what: A small knot of people on the south bank at the water's edge, between the small covered boat moored there and the great willow: a man sits on the ground holding something up, a tall capped man stands over him looking down, a smaller figure faces the tall man from the willow's foot, and someone crouches in front; a long pole or board with folds hangs between the seated and the tall man, as if wares or a cloth are being shown.
entities.note: The brief placed 'the people by the shed' at u ~20900-21100; they are at u 21047-21282, v 1230-1445. The 'shed' is the small covered boat (river_w's, mat canopy u ~21000-21200, v 1060-1120, a man and a small figure under it) moored just north of them; its crew are river_w's. Two members are conf low (see their notes).
